name: Dynamic Cache Depth Scheduling
definition: A heuristic strategy that adjusts the depth of reuse and cached parameters in subsequent frame renderings according to the intensity of decoding calculations in the derivation stage performed in the current frame rendering. It maintains image rendering quality without significant decrease or fluctuation due to cached results and suppresses rapid appearance changes caused by sudden cache flushing.
summary: Dynamic Cache Depth Scheduling is a heuristic strategy that adjusts cached computation reuse depth based on current frame decoding intensity to balance performance and visual stability in Gaussian Splatting.
